name: Shankar Chhatria / ଶଙ୍କର ଚ୍ଛତ୍ରିଆ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Shankar Chhatria contributes the Odia poem ‘ସୁଦୀର୍ଘ ପାଚେରୀ’ to Kabita Live’s September 2024 issue. Its landscape of forest, fire, river and mountain gives emotional separation a physical form. Questions about love and purity are set against images of damage and a presence that continues to offer shelter without expecting a return.

The poem moves between accusation, memory and endurance before arriving at the long wall of its title. Silence is part of that movement: what begins within a green landscape becomes the condition surrounding the final distance between two people.
